title: Baldr Sky: Gray Christmas
alt: A snowy night at a school. At the left is a long building with lit windows and a clock tower, and a square deep in snow with lamps on posts. In the square stands a Christmas tree with strings of small warm lights and a star on top, and a small red present lies in the snow. The right half of the picture is a wave of dull grey metal as high as the tower. Its crest hangs over the school, and thick grey arms that branch like frost go out from it along the roof and over the snow. Small pieces of the school break off and rise. Behind the wave a thin column of white light comes straight down through a ring in the dark cloud. Snow falls.
summary: A painting of Gray Christmas from Baldr Sky in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is Gray Christmas, the night that every story in Baldr Sky goes back to. Baldr Sky is the visual novel by Giga. On Christmas night a machine too small to see gets out of a laboratory at the academy. It is the Assembler, and it makes more of itself out of anything that it touches.

To stop it, the lance of light Gungnir is fired down from its place in the sky, and the whole quarter of the city burns. Kou loses Sora that night. Years later he still looks for the cause, as a soldier in cyberspace. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
